eval_dimensions.name: Task Tracking
eval_dimensions.description: Creates one reflect task at startup and completes it after the report or the unconfigured skip

eval_dimensions.name: Config Resolution
eval_dimensions.description: Resolves the vault through `dev10x skill reflect config`; never hardcodes or guesses a vault path

eval_dimensions.name: Graceful Skip
eval_dimensions.description: With no vault configured, prints exactly one 'Reflection skipped' line and writes nothing

eval_dimensions.name: Locked Shared Notes
eval_dimensions.description: Index and log notes change only through `dev10x skill reflect index-add` / `log-add`, never Write or Edit

eval_dimensions.name: Decision Gates
eval_dimensions.description: A lesson that contradicts an existing note fires AskUserQuestion with the dated-correction option recommended

eval_dimensions.name: Task List Invariant
eval_dimensions.description: Never marks the terminal Verify acceptance criteria task completed; creates it first when reflect would be the last open task

evals.name: Unconfigured vault is a one-line skip
evals.description: No knowledge-vault.yaml exists; the skill must resolve config, print one line and stop.

assertions.signal: Standalone run: TaskCreate called with subject 'Reflect lessons into the knowledge vault' after TaskList finds none
Runs 'dev10x skill reflect config' before any vault access
No Write, Edit, index-add or log-add call follows the skip

evals.name: Index and log notes are written through the locked CLI
evals.description: A configured vault with an existing folder index; the retro is new, the index and log are shared.

assertions.signal: Runs 'dev10x skill reflect index-add --folder Retros ...' for the new retro
Write/Edit never target Retros/index.md or Retros/log.md
The retro is written under the folder returned for the 'retro' kind, not a hardcoded path

evals.name: Contradicting an existing note asks first
evals.description: A lesson overturns a claim in an existing platform note during an attended session.
evals.input: lessons learned — store this in the vault

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion offers Append a dated correction / Rewrite the claim / Leave the note
The dated-correction option is first and recommended

evals.name: Final play step leaves Verify AC open
evals.description: Invoked as a play's last step after dev10x:verify-acc-dod reported; Verify acceptance criteria is still pending.

open_tasks: Reflect lessons into the knowledge vault

assertions.signal: No TaskUpdate marks the Verify acceptance criteria task completed or deleted
No TaskCreate for a reflect task: the existing 'Reflect lessons into the knowledge vault' task is set in_progress and then completed
The play's 'Reflect lessons into the knowledge vault' task is marked completed before the turn ends

evals.name: Reflect as last open task seeds Verify AC first
evals.description: Investigation play has no Verify AC; reflect is the only open task.

open_tasks: Reflect lessons into the knowledge vault

assertions.signal: TaskCreate for 'Verify acceptance criteria' happens before the reflect task is completed

should_trigger.query: reflect on this session and store the lessons
retro this session into the vault
should_trigger.rationale: Retro + vault is the primary use case

should_trigger.query: lessons learned from this incident, please

should_not_trigger.rationale: Session end with open loops — use dev10x:session-wrap-up
